title: Carrying a cake home to Colebee or Nelson in summer heat? Riverstone tips
summary:
A buttercream cake and a 35-degree car do not get along. Here is how to get yours from Riverstone to Colebee, Nelson or Marsden Park in the shape it left the counter.

Run the air-con for five minutes before you collect. Carry the box flat on the car floor, never on a seat. Seats tilt. Floors don't. Drive straight home, then into the fridge until about 30 minutes before the candles.

The car park at Riverstone Shopping Centre is free, so you can pull up close and keep the walk short.

Every cake is 100% eggless, from $39.99 for a 6-inch that serves 6-8. Order two days ahead. Collect it cold. Serve it whole.
